scope: Read-only launcher/source/diff, prepared snapshots, reviewed-control linkage, saved continuous-reference/native joins and hash verification. Only this prelaunch review was written; no compilation, control rerun, ray trace, staging or production mutation.
findings: All208 original pins,30 prepared files,17 candidate source files and compiler SHA verified. Copied launcher matches the maintained launcher. No execution lock or native-run output existed at review.

Candidate core is exactly the reviewed baseline with path_eval accumulator double T=0 changed to long double T=0; public return type remains double. The entire observer, driver, FMM source, gradients, source/model extraction, Armijo rule, stopping rules and update budget remain the reviewed source copies.
Prepared source map equals the passed182-control review candidate map. Frozen original-A result records equal the reviewed original observer summary and remain separate from candidate B.

Row3426 is the unique extracted comparison row for event65/receiver46 and one eligible turning reference candidate. Its grid hash equals the candidate initial grid; exact source/receiver coordinates agree. All original source and station metadata fields, full IDs/epochs and valid empty channel location are retained.
The comparison uses pure ray time without adding source_t and uses the Euclidean source-vector error against the saved reference. The25microsecond and3e-6s/km limits are unchanged.

Within candidate B, the driver independently runs observed_trace and unobserved trace on each identical straight/FMM seed. It compares action, path, projected/raw gradients, source derivatives, iterations, convergence flag, dv, length and merged-node count; the wrapper rejects any mismatch. It deliberately does not require B to equal earlier A.

The wrapper verifies settings, finite result fields, ordered native path nodes, model bounds, exact endpoints, history/table row joins and full native sidecars, then rechecks frozen and original hashes before terminal completion. Local flags and accuracy results are reported separately from diagnostic completion.

The exclusive execution lock prevents a repeated run; command failures and caught signals are recorded as failed/interrupted, with process-group termination and reaping. No interruption or lifecycle test was performed in this source review.
limitations: The unchanged C++ observer uses exact numeric operator== comparisons, not representation-bit comparisons: signed zeros compare equal. This is the declared parity scope; no bitwise claim is made.
The output name original_local_convergence_flag means candidate B's unmodified reported flag. It does not mean the pre-change A flag, which is retained separately in original_results.

Outer long-double accumulation still consumes unchanged binary64 segment values and returns binary64. This prelaunch review neither certifies action signs nor predicts convergence or source-derivative improvement.
Reference arithmetic is reused from already reviewed saved evidence; no reference re-enumeration or independent action integration was performed here.
This authorizes only the reviewed isolated diagnostic scope. One native ray cannot establish general convergence, first-arrival completeness, production promotion or inversion readiness.
